title: Wendell and the Extraction
author: N. M. Kavanagh
blurb: Wren Fairweather, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
